rules.note: Evidence that you meet the citizenship criteria (usually a copy of your valid passport). Exact proof differs by constituency; check your 'Information for Candidates' document. English translation if needed.
Head-and-shoulders colour photograph (jpg). The selection committee does not see it until after final shortlisting.
Not listed in the official requirements.
Official transcript from each college or university attended, showing grades to date. If not in English, upload the original and a certified English translation.
Complete the Rhodes CV template PDF (not more than 2 pages; extra pages are not read).
Personal statement of no more than 1,000 words, in your own voice, in English.
Academic statement of study, maximum 450 words, explaining why Oxford and your chosen course are your next academic step.

Several referees, with at least three academic and one character referee; the total number differs by constituency (for example 4 to 5). Letters on headed paper, signed, submitted online by the deadline.
